```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readxl) #reads data from Excel files
library(openxlsx) #will let me make an Excel files
library(patchwork) #helps with ggplot alignment
library(R.matlab) #interacting with MatLab
library(tidyverse) #helps tidy data, includes ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, purrr, etc.
library(deeptime) #adds timescales
```

```{r formula and example}
Ao <- 0.5 #units of Vh is kPa, units of Ao is 1/kPa [EX. HIGH Ao]
pO2 <- 8.4 #fully saturated seawater is 21 kPa [EX. HIGH O2 LEVEL 40% PAL]
B <- 1 #(B/B_ref)^ε approaches 1 bc ε approaches 0
Eo <- -0.2 #eV [EX. LOW Eo]
kB <- 8.6173303e-5 #ev/K
temp <- 283.15 #K [EX. LOW TEMP, 10 DEG C]
temp_ref <- 288.15 #K

phi <- Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB)*(1/temp - 1/temp_ref))
phi
```

```{r ecophysiotypes}
#phi for different ecophysiotypes

##Ao and Eo values estimated from Frob. This is HH, MH, HM, LH, MM, HL, LM, ML, LL
egVh <- c(10.4, 4.5, 10.4, 1.2, 4.5, 10.4, 1.2, 4.5, 1.2) 
egAo <- 1/egVh
egEo <- c(0.86, 0.86, 0.34, 0.86, 0.34, -0.03, 0.34, -0.02, -0.03)

egphiHighTLowO <- egAo * 1.05 * B * exp((egEo/kB)*(1/323.15 - 1/temp_ref)) #10% PAL, 50 deg C
egphiLowTHighO <- egAo * 8.4 * B * exp((egEo/kB)*(1/283.15 - 1/temp_ref))
```

```{r real temp data}
extinct <- c(443, 359, 252, 201, 66) #Ordovician, Devonian, Permian, Triassic, Cretaceous extinctions

tempdata <- read.csv("C:/Desktop/Science Stuff 2026/Neoprotoerzoic/scotese_bands_sst.csv") #read in Scotese et al.
head(tempdata)

phi_lowt <- Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB)*(1/(tempdata$Low_SST+273.15) - 1/temp_ref))
phi_hight <- Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB)*(1/(tempdata$High_SST+273.15) - 1/temp_ref))

tempdata_eg <- tempdata %>% #get tempdata, and then use the following functions on it
  mutate(phi_lowt = phi_lowt, phi_hight = phi_hight) %>% #create new columns
  pivot_longer(cols = c(phi_lowt, phi_hight), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi") #pivot_longer reshapes data from wide -> long format (inc. rows and dec. columns)

ggplot(tempdata_eg, aes(x = Age, y = phi, color = condition, group = condition))+#aes/aesthetics deals with visualization
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "phi", title = "Phi Visualization Example") +
  scale_x_reverse()+#reverse the axis
  scale_color_manual(values = c("phi_lowt" = "blue", "phi_hight" = "orange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = extinct)+
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r real data and ecophysiotypes}
#create an empty dataframe
tempdata_eg <- data.frame()
condition_labels <- c("HH", "MH", "HM", "LH", "MM", "HL", "LM", "ML", "LL")

#loop through conditions and compute phi values; for each value in eqAo, calculate phi based on a specific ecophysiology
for (i in seq_along(egAo)) { #seq_along generates index values for iteration purposes
  tempdata_i <- tempdata %>%
    mutate(
      phi_lowt = egAo[i] * pO2 * B * exp((egEo[i]/kB) * (1/(Low_SST+273.15) - 1/temp_ref)),
      phi_hight = egAo[i] * pO2 * B * exp((egEo[i]/kB) * (1/(High_SST+273.15) - 1/temp_ref)),
      condition = condition_labels[i]  #label each combination
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(phi_lowt, phi_hight), 
                 names_to = "temp_condition", 
                 values_to = "phi")

  tempdata_eg <- bind_rows(tempdata_eg, tempdata_i)
}

ggplot(tempdata_eg, aes(x = Age, y = phi, color = condition, linetype = temp_condition, group = interaction(condition, temp_condition))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = extinct)+
  labs(x = "Age", y = "phi", title = "Phi Visualization for High and Low Lat SSTs") +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("phi_lowt" = "solid", "phi_hight" = "dashed")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r paleozoic - oxygen, echo=TRUE}
#oxygen increase scenario, T constant
time <- seq(900, 500, by = -1)  
pO2 <- ifelse(time >= 550, 0.42, 2.1) #2% to 10% 
temp <- rep(303.15, length(time)) #temp remains constant at 30 degC (temp <- 303.15 is fine for regular math but need this for df/plotting)

#average
Ao_avg <- 1/4.5  
Eo_avg <- 0.34  
#good at hypoxia, bad at T
Ao_O2 <- 1/1.2  
Eo_O2 <- 0.86  
#good at T, bad at hypoxia
Ao_T <- 1/10.4
Eo_T <- 0.01 #Frob uses -0.03 but I'll use this instead 

phi_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp - 1/temp_ref))
phi_O2 <- Ao_O2 * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp - 1/temp_ref))
phi_T <- Ao_T * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp - 1/temp_ref))

#convert data to long format for ggplot
df1 <- data.frame(time, pO2, temp)
df1_long <- df1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pO2, temp), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
#rescale temperature to match the oxygen scale (0-21)
  mutate(scaled_value = ifelse( #create new column
    variable == "temp", #for each row, checks whether the variable column is equal to "temp".
    scales::rescale(value, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 310)), #scale temp range to match pO2 axis, :: accesses exact function from a package
    value #keep pO2 as is
  ))

df2 <- data.frame(time, phi_avg, phi_O2, phi_T)
#convert to long format for ggplot
df2_long <- df2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(phi_avg, phi_O2, phi_T), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi")

#context plot
p1 <- ggplot(df1_long, aes(x = time, y = scaled_value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse()+ 
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 21), #keep oxygen scale fixed
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * (310-280)/21 + 280, name = "Temperature (K)") #sec.axis relabes the y-axis, taking the primary axis values (i.e., .), multiplying them by (310-280)/21, then adding 280)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "temp" = "orange"))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+#mark transition point
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 660, xmax = 717, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+#Sturtian (semi-transparent blue)
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 632.3, xmax = 654.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+#Marinoan (semi-transparent blue)
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Oxygen (kPa)", title = "Oxygen and Temperature") +
  theme_minimal()
#phi plot
p2 <- ggplot(df2_long, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("phi_avg" = "black", "phi_O2" = "blue", "phi_T" = "green")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 660, xmax = 717, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Sturtian (semi-transparent blue)
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 632.3, xmax = 654.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Marinoan (semi-transparent blue)
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time")+
  theme_minimal()

o2plot <- p1+p2
o2plot
ggsave(plot=o2plot,
       "o2plot.pdf")
```
```{r paleozoic - temp, echo=TRUE}
#temperature increase scenario, oxygen constant
time <- seq(900, 500, by = -1)  
pO2 <- rep(2.1, length(time)) #10% PAL constant
temp <- ifelse(time >= 710, 308.15, 
               ifelse(time > 600, 298.15, 
                      ifelse(time >= 538.8, 298.15 - (5 * (600-time)/(600-538.8)), 293.15)))

df3 <- data.frame(time, pO2, temp)
df3_long <- df3 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pO2, temp), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
#rescale temperature to match oxygen's axis range (0-21)
  mutate(scaled_value = ifelse(
    variable == "temp", 
    scales::rescale(value, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 320)), #scale from 280-320 to 0-21
    value #keep pO2 as is
  ))

#create a second data frame for phi values
df4 <- data.frame(time, phi_avg, phi_O2, phi_T)
#convert to long format for ggplot
df4_long <- df4 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(phi_avg, phi_O2, phi_T), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi")

#context plot
p1 <- ggplot(df3_long, aes(x = time, y = scaled_value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse()+#reverse time axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 21), #keep oxygen scale fixed
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * (max(df1$temp) - min(df3$temp))/21 + min(df3$temp), 
                        name = "Temperature (K)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "temp" = "orange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 660, xmax = 717, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Sturtian (semi-transparent blue), alpha defines transparency
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 632.3, xmax = 654.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Marinoan (semi-transparent blue)
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Oxygen (kPa)", title = "Oxygen and Temperature") +
  theme_minimal()
#phi plot
p2 <- ggplot(df4_long, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("phi_avg" = "black", "phi_O2" = "blue", "phi_T" = "green")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 660, xmax = 717, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Sturtian (semi-transparent blue)
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 632.3, xmax = 654.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Marinoan (semi-transparent blue)
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time") +
  theme_minimal()

tempplot <- p1+p2
tempplot
ggsave(plot=tempplot,
       "tempplot.pdf")
```

```{r paleozoic actual figs, echo=TRUE}
time <- seq(900, 500, by = -1)  
pO2 <- rep(2.1, length(time)) #10% constant
pO2_change <- ifelse(time >= 550, 0.42, 4.2) #2% to 20%

#SET 1 - demonstration of idea: O2 steady, T drops (high and moderate change); O2 steady, T increases (moderate to high)

#temperature drops
temp_drop <- ifelse(time > 640, 308.15, 298.15)

phi1_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp_drop - 1/temp_ref))
phi1_O2 <- Ao_O2 * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp_drop - 1/temp_ref))
phi1_T <- Ao_T * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp_drop - 1/temp_ref))

set1_df1 <- data.frame(time, pO2, temp_drop)
set1_df1_long <- set1_df1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pO2, temp_drop), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(scaled_value = ifelse(
    variable == "temp_drop", 
    scales::rescale(value, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 320)), #scale from 280-320 to 0-21
    value #keep pO2 as is
  ))

set1_df2 <- data.frame(time, phi1_avg, phi1_O2, phi1_T)
set1_df2_long <- set1_df2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(phi1_avg, phi1_O2, phi1_T), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi")

set1_p1 <- ggplot(set1_df1_long, aes(x = time, y = scaled_value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse()+ #reverse time axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 21),  #keep oxygen scale fixed
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * (max(set1_df1$temp_drop) - min(set1_df1$temp_drop))/21 + min(set1_df1$temp_drop), 
                        name = "Temperature (K)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "temp_drop" = "orange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Oxygen (kPa)", title = "O2 = 10%, T = 35 to 25C") +
  theme_minimal()

set1_p2 <- ggplot(set1_df2_long, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("phi1_avg" = "black", "phi1_O2" = "blue", "phi1_T" = "green")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time") +
  theme_minimal()

set1_p1+set1_p2

#temperature increases
temp_jump <- ifelse(time < 640, 308.15, 298.15)

phi1a_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp_jump - 1/temp_ref))
phi1a_O2 <- Ao_O2 * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp_jump - 1/temp_ref))
phi1a_T <- Ao_T * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp_jump - 1/temp_ref))

set1a_df1 <- data.frame(time, pO2, temp_jump)
set1a_df1_long <- set1a_df1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pO2, temp_jump), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(scaled_value = ifelse(
    variable == "temp_jump", 
    scales::rescale(value, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 320)), #scale from 280-320 to 0-21
    value  #keep pO2 as is
  ))

set1a_df2 <- data.frame(time, phi1a_avg, phi1a_O2, phi1a_T)
set1a_df2_long <- set1a_df2 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(phi1a_avg, phi1a_O2, phi1a_T), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi")

set1a_p1 <- ggplot(set1a_df1_long, aes(x = time, y = scaled_value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse()+#reverse time axis
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 21), #keep oxygen scale fixed
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * (max(set1a_df1$temp_jump) - min(set1a_df1$temp_jump))/21 + min(set1a_df1$temp_jump), 
                    name = "Temperature (K)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "temp_jump" = "orange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Oxygen (kPa)", title = "O2 = 10%, T = 25 to 35C") +
  theme_minimal()

set1a_p2 <- ggplot(set1a_df2_long, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("phi1a_avg" = "black", "phi1a_O2" = "blue", "phi1a_T" = "green")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time") +
  theme_minimal()

set1a_p1+set1a_p2

set2_p2 <- ggplot(set2_df2_long, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +

  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 632.3, xmax = 654.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.05, color=NA)+ #Marinoan (semi-transparent blue)
  labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time") +

set2_p1+set2_p2

#SET 3 - with glaciations → moderately hot world: O2 steady; O2 increases
temp_warm <- ifelse(time >= 710, 308.15, 
               ifelse(time > 640, 298.15, 
                 ifelse(time >= 538.8, 
                        298.15+(301.15-298.15) * ((640-time)/(640-538.8)), 
                        301)))

#O2 steady
phi3_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp_warm - 1/temp_ref))
phi3_O2 <- Ao_O2 * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp_warm - 1/temp_ref))
phi3_T <- Ao_T * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp_warm - 1/temp_ref))

    scales::rescale(value, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 320)),

                    name = "Temperature (K)")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "temp_warm" = "orange")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
```

```{r new scenarios for temperature, echo=TRUE}
time <- seq(600, 700, by = 0.1)

#parameter grid
initial_C <- c(43, 40, 35)
drop_C <- c(28, 25)
pO2_vals <- c(1.05, 2.4, 4.2, 8.4)
param_grid <- expand.grid(start_temp_C = initial_C, drop_temp_C = drop_C, pO2 = pO2_vals)

#function to simulate and plot each scenario
plot_pair <- function(start_temp_C, drop_temp_C, pO2) {
  temp_drop <- ifelse(time >= 640, start_temp_C+273.15, drop_temp_C+273.15)
  #phi calculations
  phi1_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp_drop - 1/temp_ref))
  phi1_O2 <- Ao_O2 * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp_drop - 1/temp_ref))
  phi1_T  <- Ao_T  * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp_drop - 1/temp_ref))
  df_phi <- tibble( #constructs a dataframe
    time = time,
    phi1_avg = phi1_avg,
    phi1_O2 = phi1_O2,
    phi1_T = phi1_T
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("phi1"), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi")
  #context plot
  temp_scaled <- scales::rescale(temp_drop, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 320))
  df_context <- tibble(time = time, pO2 = pO2, scaled_temp = temp_scaled) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(pO2, scaled_temp), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
  context_plot <- ggplot(df_context, aes(x = time, y = value, color = variable)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 21),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * (320 - 280)/21 + 280, name = "Temperature (K)")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "scaled_temp" = "orange")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 640, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      x = "Time (Ma)",
      y = "Oxygen (kPa)",
      title = paste("Oxygen and Temperature",
                    start_temp_C, "→", drop_temp_C, "°C |", pO2, "kPa")
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  #phi plot
  phi_plot <- ggplot(df_phi, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("phi1_avg" = "black", "phi1_O2" = "blue", "phi1_T" = "green")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 640, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time") +
    theme_minimal()
    return(context_plot+phi_plot)  #create side-by-side plots using patchwork
}

#generate and optionally save/view all plots
plots <- purrr::pmap(param_grid, plot_pair) #purr:: specifies the purr package, pmap creates parallel maps

plots[[1]] #view the first pair
```

```{r new scenarios for oxygen, echo=TRUE}
temp <- 25+273.15
time <- seq(600, 700, by = 0.1)
target_pO2 <- c(2.1, 4.2, 8.4) #oxygen rise scenarios (start at 1.05 kPa, jump at 640 Ma)

#function to simulate and plot each scenario
plot_pair <- function(final_pO2) {
  pO2_over_time <- ifelse(time > 640, 1.05, final_pO2)
  #phi calculations
  phi2_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2_over_time * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp - 1/temp_ref))
  phi2_O2 <- Ao_O2 * pO2_over_time * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp - 1/temp_ref))
  phi2_T  <- Ao_T  * pO2_over_time * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp - 1/temp_ref))
  df_phi <- tibble(
    time = time,
    phi2_avg = phi2_avg,
    phi2_O2 = phi2_O2,
    phi2_T = phi2_T
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("phi2"), names_to = "condition", values_to = "phi")
  #context plot
  temp_scaled <- scales::rescale(temp, to = c(0, 21), from = c(280, 320))
  df_context <- tibble(time = time, pO2 = pO2_over_time, Scaled_Temp = temp_scaled) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(pO2, Scaled_Temp), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
  context_plot <- ggplot(df_context, aes(x = time, y = value, color = variable)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 21),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * (320 - 280)/21 + 280, name = "Temperature (K)")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "blue", "Scaled_Temp" = "orange")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 640, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      x = "Time (Ma)",
      y = "Oxygen (kPa)",
      title = paste("O₂ Rise at Constant 25°C:", "1.05 →", final_pO2, "kPa")
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  #phi plot
  phi_plot <- ggplot(df_phi, aes(x = time, y = phi, color = condition)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("phi2_avg" = "black", "phi2_O2" = "blue", "phi2_T" = "green")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 640, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Time (Ma)", y = "Phi", title = "Phi Over Time") +
    theme_minimal()

  return(context_plot+phi_plot)
}

#generate plots for each final pO2
plots <- purrr::map(target_pO2, plot_pair)

plots[[1]]
```

```{r new scenarios for glaciations, echo=FALSE}
#parameters
initial_C <- c(43, 40, 35) #warmer
initial_C <- c(40, 35, 30) #cooler
drop1_C <- 35 #hotter
drop2_C <- 30 #hotter
#drop1_C <- 30 #cooler
#drop2_C <- 25 #cooler
pO2_rise <- c(2.1, 4.2, 8.4)
pO2_start <- 1.05

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  start_temp_C = initial_C,
  drop1_temp_C = drop1_C,
  drop2_temp_C = drop2_C,
  pO2_final = pO2_rise
)

param_grid <- tibble::tibble( #for fig 3
  start_temp_C = c(40, 40, 40),
  drop1_temp_C = c(30, 30, 35),
  drop2_temp_C = c(25, 25, 30),
  pO2_final    = c(2.1, 10.5, 10.5)
)

#plotting function
plot_pair <- function(start_temp_C, drop1_temp_C, drop2_temp_C, pO2_final) {
  time <- seq(900, 500, length.out = 100)
  temp_C <- ifelse(
  time >= 710, start_temp_C, #initial warm state
  ifelse(
    time > 640, drop1_temp_C, #immediate drop to 28 °C
    ifelse(
      time >= 538.8, #gradual drop from 28 → 25 °C
      drop1_temp_C - (drop1_temp_C - drop2_temp_C) * ((640-time)/(640-538.8)),
      drop2_temp_C #plateau at 25 °C
    )
  )
)
  temp_K <- temp_C+273.15
  pO2 <- ifelse(time <= 538.8, pO2_final, 1.05)
  #phi calculations
  phi_avg <- Ao_avg * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_avg/kB) * (1/temp_K - 1/temp_ref))
  phi_O2  <- Ao_O2 * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_O2/kB) * (1/temp_K - 1/temp_ref))
  phi_T   <- Ao_T  * pO2 * B * exp((Eo_T/kB) * (1/temp_K - 1/temp_ref))
  #data for phi plot
  df_phi <- tibble(
    time = time,
    phi_avg = phi_avg,
    phi_O2 = phi_O2,
    phi_T = phi_T
  ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("phi_"), names_to = "Condition", values_to = "Phi")
  #context plot
  scale_T_to_O2 <- function(temp_C) (temp_C-20)/(45-20) * 21
  scale_O2_to_T <- function(y) 20 + (y/21) * (45-20)
  guides <- seq(20, 45, 5)
  diff_values <- pO2 - scale_T_to_O2(temp_C) #this section basically makes sure the two axes show up properly
  sign_changes <- which(diff(sign(diff_values)) != 0)
  if(length(sign_changes) > 0) {
    idx <- sign_changes[length(sign_changes)]
    x1 <- time[idx]
    x2 <- time[idx+1]
    y1 <- diff_values[idx]
    y2 <- diff_values[idx+1]
    intersection_time <- x1 - y1 * (x2-x1)/(y2-y1)
  } else {
    intersection_time <- time[which.min(abs(diff_values))]
  }
 context_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = tibble(time, pO2 = pO2),
      aes(x = time, y = pO2, color = "pO2"),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = tibble(time, temp_C = temp_C),
      aes(x = time, y = scale_T_to_O2(temp_C), color = "temp_C"),
      linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "pO2",
      limits = c(0, 21),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        transform = ~ scale_O2_to_T(.),
        name = "Temperature (°C)",
        breaks = guides
      )
    ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pO2" = "darkblue", "temp_C" = "orange"))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+ #Cambrian explosion
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 717, xmax = 660, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), #Sturtian glaciation 
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 654.5, xmax = 632.3, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), #Marinoan glaciation
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  labs(
    x = "Time (Myr ago)",
    title = paste(
      "O2 =", pO2_start, "→", pO2_final, 
      "kPa; Temp:", start_temp_C, "→", drop1_temp_C, "→", drop2_temp_C, "°C"
    ),
    color = NULL
  ) +
    coord_geo(  #deep time scale
      xlim = c(900, 500),  #limit the x-axis to 700 - 500 Ma
      dat = list("periods"),  
      size = list(3, 2),   #size for period and epoch labels
      abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
      height = unit(1, "line")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
theme(
  legend.position = "top",
  plot.title = element_text(size = 15)
)
  #phi plot
  phi_plot <- ggplot(df_phi, aes(x = time, y = Phi, color = Condition))+
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    scale_x_reverse()+ #reverse time scale
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("phi_avg" = "black", "phi_O2" = "blue", "phi_T" = "red"),
      labels = c("Average", "Hypoxia tolerant", "Heat tolerant"),
      name = NULL)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 538.8, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
    labs(x = "Time (Myr ago)", y = "Φ", title = "Φ over Time")+
    coord_geo( #deep time scale
      xlim = c(900, 500),  
      ylim = c(0, 3),
      dat = list("periods"),  
      size = list(3, 2),   
      abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
      height = unit(1, "line")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  plot.title = element_text(size = 15)
)
  phi_plot <- phi_plot +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 717, xmax = 660, ymin = 0, ymax = 3,
           fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 654.5, xmax = 632.3, ymin = 0, ymax = 3,
           fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, color = "green", linetype = "dashed")+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 575, color = "gold", linetype = "solid")+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 560, color = "gold", linetype = "dotdash")+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 550, color = "gold", linetype = "dotted")
  return(context_plot+ phi_plot)
}

#generate all plot combinations

plots
```

```{r metabolic index}
#get temperatures and pO2 values
tempC_range <- seq(0, 40, by = 0.1) #Judd et al.
pO2_range <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.1) #Mills et al.
enviro_grid <- expand.grid(tempC = tempC_range, pO2 = pO2_range)
enviro_grid$tempK <- enviro_grid$tempC+273.15

#ecophysiotypes from Frob et al. 
ecophys <- data.frame(
  type = c("Average", "Hypoxia tolerant", 
           "Heat tolerant"),
  Ao = c(1/4.5, 1/1.2, 1/7),
  Eo = c(0.34, 0.86, 0.05) #Frob defines -0.03, using 0.05 here. 
)

#get phi for each ecophysiotype
phi_data <- bind_rows(lapply(1:nrow(ecophys), function(i) { #from row  1 to the total # of rows, run this function...
  row <- ecophys[i, ] #grab a given row and save the traits (Ao and Eo)
  df <- enviro_grid
  df$type <- row$type
  df$phi <- row$Ao * df$pO2 * B * exp((row$Eo/kB) * (1/df$tempK - 1/temp_ref))
  df
}))

ggplot(phi_data, aes(x = tempC, y = pO2, fill = phi)) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE)+ #creates a colored heatmap
  facet_wrap(~type, nrow = 1)+ #creates a collection of plots where each othe represents a subset of the data
  geom_contour(aes(z = phi), breaks = c(1), color = "black", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8)+ #phi = 1 (dashed) 
  geom_contour(aes(z = phi), breaks = c(2.5), color = "black", linetype = "solid", size = 0.8)+ #phi = 3 (solid)
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", trans = "log10", name = expression(Phi)) +
  labs(
    x = "Seawater Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Seawater pO2 (kPa)",

  ) +

  )

#discrete colors
phi_colors <- phi_data %>%
  mutate(phi_category = case_when(
    phi > 2.5 ~ "Ecologically viable (Φ > 2.5)",
    phi >= 1 & phi <= 2.5 ~ "Minimum pO2 for survival (1 ≤ Φ ≤ 2.5)",
    phi < 1 ~ "Below standard metabolic rate (Φ < 1)"
  )) %>%
  mutate(phi_category = factor(
    phi_category,
    levels = c(
      "Ecologically viable (Φ > 2.5)",
      "Minimum pO2 for survival (1 ≤ Φ ≤ 2.5)",
      "Below standard metabolic rate (Φ < 1)"
    )
  ))

#plot
phi_fig <- ggplot(phi_colors, aes(x = tempC, y = pO2, fill = phi_category)) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~type, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = expression(phi~"category"),
    values = c(
      "Ecologically viable (Φ > 2.5)" = "blue",
      "Minimum pO2 for survival (1 ≤ Φ ≤ 2.5)" = "orange",
      "Below standard metabolic rate (Φ < 1)" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Seawater temperature (°C)",
    y = "Seawater pO2 (kPa)",
    title = "Φ for three key ecophysiotypes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
ggsave(

  plot = phi_fig,                    
  width = 10,                        
  height = 4,                         
  units = "in",                   
  dpi = 1000 #useful for raster layers
)
```

```{r monte carlo}
n_iter <- 500 #set # of iterations

setwd("C:/Neoprotoerzoic")
#datasets
mills_old <- read_csv("MillsO2.csv") #columns: Time, Mid, Min, Max
mills <- read_csv("GCBS4_outputs_14_7_2022.csv")
judd_old <- read_csv("JuddT.csv") #columns: UpperAge, LowerAge, AverageAge, GMST_05, GMST_95
judd <- read_csv("judd_bands_sst.csv") #columns: Age_Mean, Low_95, High_95 , get uncertainties for both low and high latitudes
scotese <- read_csv("scotese_bands_sst.csv") #Low_SST and High_SST
penn <- read_csv("Penn_2018_ecophysiotypes.csv") #Ao and Eo values
bergmann <- read_csv("Temperature_Deciles_CambroOrdovician_Apatite5Ma.csv")

time_steps_S <- seq(-540, 0, by = 5) #Scotese goes up to 541 Ma
time_steps_J <- seq(-480, 0, by = 5) #Judd goes up to 480 Ma
time_steps_B <- seq(-520, -445, by = 5)

time_data_scoteseL <- lapply(time_steps_S, function(t) {
  #find nearest rows in each dataset
  o2_row <- mills %>% slice(which.min(abs(Time-t)))
  temp_row <- scotese %>% slice(which.min(abs(Age-abs(t)))) #if Age is positive
  temp_min <- temp_row$Low_SST-3 #creating an artificial error of +/- 2. Average error in Judd
  temp_max <- temp_row$Low_SST+3 #creating an artificial error of +/- 2
  data.frame(
    time = abs(t),  
    temp_min = temp_min,
    temp_max = temp_max,
    pO2_min = o2_row$Min * (101.325/100), #converting % atm to kPa
    pO2_max = o2_row$Max * (101.325/100) #converting % atm  to kPa
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

time_data_juddL <- lapply(time_steps_J, function(t) {
  #find nearest rows in each dataset
  o2_row <- mills %>% slice(which.min(abs(Time-t)))
  temp_row <- judd %>% slice(which.min(abs(Age_Mean-abs(t)))) #if Age is positive
  temp_min <- temp_row$Low_5
  temp_max <- temp_row$Low_95
  data.frame(
    time = abs(t),  
    temp_min = temp_min,
    temp_max = temp_max,
    pO2_min = o2_row$Min * (101.325/100), #converting % atm to kPa
    pO2_max = o2_row$Max * (101.325/100) #converting % atm to kPa
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

time_data_Berg <- lapply(time_steps_B, function(t) {
  age <- abs(t)
  o2_row <- mills %>% #nearest oxygen record
    slice(which.min(abs(Time-t)))
  temp_row <- bergmann %>% #nearest temperature record
    slice(which.min(abs(`Age Center (Ma)`-age)))
  temp <- temp_row$`10th (°C)`
  temp50 <- temp_row$`50th (°C)`
  data.frame(
    time = age,
    temp_min = temp-3,
    temp_max = temp+3,
    temp50_min = temp50-3,
    temp50_max = temp50+3,
    pO2_min = o2_row$Min * (101.325/100), #converting % atm to kPa
    pO2_max = o2_row$Max * (101.325/100) #converting % atm to kPa
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

#physiology parameter ranges
Ao_range <- c(1/10, 1/1)
Eo_range <- c(0.05, 0.86)
param_samples <- data.frame( #sample arbitrary Ao/Eo values from the Ao range; [1] and [2] define the upper/lower bounds
  Ao = runif(n_iter, Ao_range[1], Ao_range[2]),
  Eo = runif(n_iter, Eo_range[1], Eo_range[2])
)

#run Monte Carlo for Ao and Eo ranges
set.seed(21)
results_scoteseL <- time_data_scoteseL %>% #Scotese et al
  rowwise() %>% #look at data one row at a time
  do({
    t_row <- . #. = current row being processed
    data.frame(
      time = t_row$time,
      tempC = runif(n_iter, t_row$temp_min, t_row$temp_max), #pick value between range
      pO2 = runif(n_iter, t_row$pO2_min, t_row$pO2_max),
      param_samples
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        tempK = tempC+273.15, #convert to Kelvin
        phi = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB)*(1/tempK - 1/temp_ref)) #metabolic index
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

results_juddL <- time_data_juddL %>% #Judd et al
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    t_row <- .
    data.frame(
      time = t_row$time,
      tempC = runif(n_iter, t_row$temp_min, t_row$temp_max), #pick value between range (same goes for next 3 rows)
      pO2 = runif(n_iter, t_row$pO2_min, t_row$pO2_max),
      param_samples
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        tempK = tempC+273.15, #convert to Kelvin
        phi = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB)*(1/tempK - 1/temp_ref)) #metabolic index
      )
  }) %>%

results_Berg <- time_data_Berg %>% #Bergmann et al
  rowwise() %>%

    t_row <- .
    data.frame(

    ) %>%

        tempK = tempC+273.15, #convert to Kelvin
        phi = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB)*(1/tempK - 1/temp_ref)) #metabolic index

#summarize phi envelope

      pO2 = pO2,
      Ao = Ao_vals,
      Eo = Eo_vals
    ) %>%
      mutate(

  )

  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#now using 3 distinct ecophysiotypes from the Neoprotoerzoic fig.s
#average
Ao_avg <- 1/4.5  
Eo_avg <- 0.34  
#good at hypoxia, bad at T

Eo_O2 <- 0.86  
#good at T, bad at hypoxia
Ao_T <- 1/10.4
Eo_T <- 0.01 #Frob uses -0.03 but I'll use this instead 

#Monte Carlo
set.seed(21)

param_sets <- list(
  Average = list(Ao = Ao_avg, Eo = Eo_avg),
  Oxygen  = list(Ao = Ao_O2,  Eo = Eo_O2),
  Temp = list(Ao = Ao_T,  Eo = Eo_T)
)

results_psL3 <- map_dfr(names(param_sets), function(set_name) {
  params <- param_sets[[set_name]]
  time_data_scoteseL %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    do({
      t_row <- .
      tempC <- runif(n_iter, t_row$temp_min, t_row$temp_max)
      pO2 <- runif(n_iter, t_row$pO2_min, t_row$pO2_max)
      tibble(
        time = t_row$time,
        tempC = tempC,
        pO2 = pO2,
        Ao = params$Ao,
        Eo = params$Eo
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          tempK = tempC+273.15,
          phi = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB) * (1/tempK - 1/temp_ref))
        )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(param_set = set_name)
})

results_pjL3 <- map_dfr(names(param_sets), function(set_name) {
  params <- param_sets[[set_name]]
  time_data_juddL %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    do({
      t_row <- .
      tempC <- runif(n_iter, t_row$temp_min, t_row$temp_max)
      pO2 <- runif(n_iter, t_row$pO2_min, t_row$pO2_max)
      tibble(
        time = t_row$time,
        tempC = tempC,
        pO2 = pO2,
        Ao = params$Ao,
        Eo = params$Eo
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          tempK = tempC+273.15,
          phi = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB) * (1/tempK - 1/temp_ref))
        )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(param_set = set_name)
})

results_pB3 <- map_dfr(names(param_sets), function(set_name) {
  params <- param_sets[[set_name]]
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(time_data_Berg)), function(i) {
    t_row <- time_data_Berg[i, ]
    tempC <- runif(n_iter, t_row$temp_min, t_row$temp_max)
    temp50C <- runif(n_iter, t_row$temp50_min, t_row$temp50_max)
    pO2 <- runif(n_iter, t_row$pO2_min, t_row$pO2_max)
    tibble(
      time= t_row$time,
      tempC = tempC,
      temp50C = temp50C,
      pO2 = pO2,
      Ao = params$Ao,
      Eo = params$Eo
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        tempK = tempC+273.15,
        temp50K = temp50C+273.15,
        phi = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB) * (1/tempK - 1/temp_ref)),
        phi50 = Ao * pO2 * B * exp((Eo/kB) * (1/temp50K - 1/temp_ref)),
      )
  }) %>%
  mutate(param_set = set_name)
})

                  ymax = Max * (101.325/100)),
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = (Min+Max)/2 * (101.325/100)), color = "blue", size = 1
            ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Mills O2 (kPa)",
    x = "Time (Myr ago)",
    y = "pO2 (kPa)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10))+
  coord_geo(
    xlim = c(550, 0),
    ylim = c(0, 45),
    dat = list("periods"),
    size = list(3, 2),   #periods' abbr size = 3, epochs' abbr size = 2
    abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
    height = unit(1, "line")
)

#constant O2 version - if using, will need to make edits throughout the following code to accomodate!
p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 21, color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  #optional light band to mimic your old ribbon look
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 550, ymin = 20.5, ymax = 21.5),
            fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_x_reverse(limits = c(550, 0), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Constant O2 = 21 kPa",
    x = "Time (Myr ago)",
    y = "pO2 (kPa)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  coord_geo(
    xlim = c(550, 0),
    ylim = c(0, 45),
    dat = list("periods"),
    size = list(3, 2),
    abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
    height = unit(1, "line")
  )

#make labelled dataframes
scotese_plot <- scotese %>%
  mutate(Source = "Scotese")
judd_plot <- judd %>%
  mutate(Source = "Judd")
bergmann_plot <- bergmann %>%
  mutate(Source = "Bergmann")

#panel 2 – temperature estimates (Scotese et al + Judd et al)
p2 <- ggplot() +
  #Scotese et al low SST ±3
  geom_ribbon(data = scotese_plot, 
              aes(x = Age,
                  ymin = Low_SST-3,
                  ymax = Low_SST+3,
                  fill = Source),
              alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = scotese_plot,
            aes(x = Age, y = Low_SST, color = Source),
            linewidth = 1) +
  #Judd et al low-lat
  geom_ribbon(data = judd_plot,
              aes(x = Age_Mean,
                  ymin = Low_5,
                  ymax = Low_95,
                  fill = Source),
              alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = judd_plot,
            aes(x = Age_Mean, y = (Low_5+Low_95)/2, color = Source),
            linewidth = 1) +
  #Bergmann et al
  geom_ribbon(data = bergmann_plot, 
              aes(x = `Age Center (Ma)`,
                  ymin = `10th (°C)`-3,
                  ymax = `50th (°C)`+3,
                  fill = Source),
              alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = bergmann_plot,
            aes(x = `Age Center (Ma)`, y = `10th (°C)`, color = Source),
            linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Scotese" = "blue", "Judd" = "darkorange", "Bergmann"="purple")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Scotese" = "skyblue", "Judd" = "goldenrod1", "Bergmann"="#CBC3e3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Low-Latitude Temperature",
    x = "Time (Myr ago)",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    fill = "Dataset",
    color = "Dataset"
  )+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  coord_geo(
    xlim = c(540, 0),
    ylim = c(20, 50),
    dat = list("periods"),
    size = list(3, 2), 
    abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
    height = unit(1, "line")
)

#panel 3 – JuddT LowLat + Bergmann metabolic index envelope
p3 <- ggplot(phi_pjL3, aes(x = time, fill = param_set, color = param_set)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = phi_min, ymax = phi_max), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = phi_median), linewidth = 1) +
  #Bergmann envelope
  geom_ribbon(
    data = phi_pB3,
    aes(x = time, ymin = phi_min, ymax = phi50_max, fill = param_set),
    alpha = 0.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = phi_pB3,
    aes(x = time, y = phi_median, color = param_set),
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = param_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = param_colors) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Φ Envelope – JuddTlowLat + MillsO2 with Bergmann comparison",
    x = "Time (Myr ago)", 
    y = expression(Phi)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  coord_geo(
    xlim = c(540, 0),
    ylim = c(0, 12),
    dat = list("periods"),
    size = list(3, 2),
    abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
    height = unit(1, "line")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, color = "green", linetype = "dashed")

#panel 4 – Scotese et al
p4 <- ggplot(phi_psL3, aes(x = time, fill = param_set, color = param_set)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = phi_min, ymax = phi_max), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = phi_median), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = param_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = param_colors) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,6)) +
  labs(
    title = "Φ Envelope – ScoteseTlowLat + MillsO2",
    x = "Time (Myr ago)", y = expression(Phi)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size=10))+
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  coord_geo(
    xlim = c(540, 0),
    ylim = c(0, 12),
    dat = list("periods"),
    size = list(3, 2),   #periods' abbr size = 3, epochs' abbr size = 2
    abbrv = list(TRUE, TRUE),
    height = unit(1, "line")
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, color = "green", linetype = "dashed")

phan_fig <- (p1 | p2)/(p3 | p4)+#combines the panels into a 2x2 layout w/ patchwork
plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))

print(phan_fig)

pdf("phan_fig.pdf", width = 12, height = 6)
print(phan_fig) 
dev.off()
```

```{r fig max thickness}
k = 2.27e-3 #oxygen permiability within organism in cm2/atm/h
Pe = 0.21 #environmental oxygen level in atm
Pmin = 6.579e-4 #minimum viable oxygen level in organism in atm
m = 0.5413 #mass-specific metabolic rate in cm3 O2/cm3 tissue/hr

#get q10
temps <- 30:60
rates <- m * 2^((temps-30)/10)
rates

q10_table <- data.frame(
  Temperature = temps,
  Rate = rates
)

q10_table

Rmax = 2 * sqrt((k*(Pe-Pmin))/m)
Rmax #maxmimum radius in cm

maxrad <- read_csv("C:Neoprotoerzoic/Maximum_thickness.csv")
head(maxrad)

df_long <- maxrad %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Max thickness (5% PAL)`, `Max thickness (10% PAL)`, `Max thickness (20% PAL)`), 
    names_to = "variable",   
    values_to = "value"       
  )

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = `Temperature`, y = value, color = variable)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(color = "Y Variables", y = "Maximum tissue thickness (cm)", title = "Max tissue thickness")

#constants
k <- 2.27e-3 #oxygen permeability (cm2/atm/h)
Pmin <- 6.579e-4 #minimum viable oxygen (atm)
#m_ref <- 0.5413 #reference metabolic rate at 20°C - no circ
m_ref <- 0.1515 #reference metabolic rate at 20°C - circ
Q10 <- 2 #Q10
d <- 0.002 #diffusional distance between blood and surface of organism (cm)

#temperature range
temps <- 10:50

#fraction of present atmospheric level (PAL)
PAL <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1)

#create an empty data frame to store results
Rmax_df <- expand.grid(
  Temperature = temps,
  PAL = PAL
) %>%
  mutate(
    #calculate temperature-adjusted metabolic rate
    MetabolicRate = m_ref * Q10^((Temperature-20)/10),
    #calculate environmental oxygen
    Pe = PAL*0.21,
    Pb = 0.25*Pe, #average oxygen concentration in blood, only for cirulatory system
    #calculate Rmax
    #MaxRadius = 2 * sqrt(k * (Pe - Pmin)/MetabolicRate) #no circulatory system
    MaxRadius = 2 * k* (Pe-Pb)/(MetabolicRate*d) #circulatory system
  )

#make PAL a factor for plotting
Rmax_df$PAL <- factor(Rmax_df$PAL, labels = c("1% PAL", "5% PAL", "10% PAL", "20% PAL","30% PAL", "40% PAL", "50% PAL", "60% PAL",
                                              "70% PAL", "80% PAL", "90% PAL", "100% PAL"))

head(Rmax_df, 10)

#plot MaxRadius vs Temperature for each PAL
bodysizemax <- ggplot(Rmax_df, aes(x = Temperature, y = MaxRadius, color = PAL)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Maximum radius (cm)",
    color = "Oxygen level",
    title = "Maximum radius (cm) vs temperature (°C)"
  ) +
   theme_minimal(base_size = 15)+
    theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size =15)
  )

pdf("max_radius.pdf", width = 9, height = 6)

print(bodysizemax)

dev.off()
```
